data.display_address: Palace Beach Residence, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Palace Beach Residence at Emaar Beachfront is a newly launched luxury development offering a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom waterfront apartments, complemented by upscale amenities. This prestigious project features two stunning towers, standing at 29 and 42 storeys, designed to deliver an exceptional beachside lifestyle.

Located within the serene Emaar Beachfront, renowned for its resort-style living, the development benefits from a prime position that ensures easy access to Dubai’s iconic destinations. Residents can quickly reach key locations like Skydive Dubai, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Ain Dubai, and Marina Beach, all just minutes away from their doorstep.

Key Highlights

• Newly launched residential waterfront development
• Waterfront apartments at Emaar Beachfront
• Marina Skyline & Beach Park facing Residences
• Unparallel views of the Palm and Ain Dubai
• Dubai Marina at your doorstep
• Premium lifestyle overlooking the majestic Arabian Sea

Features and Amenities

• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gym
• Children’s Play Area
• BBQ Facilities
• Parks and Leisure Spaces
• 24/7 Security

Experience the stunning views from the balcony extending the perceptual depth and composition that reflect the views of fiberglass of superyachts. Meanwhile, the development connects the building with the crystal clear blue waters.
